title: General information for statistics students
text:
This page collects general information for students at the Department of Statistics, Stockholm University.

Calculators in the exam rooms

title: Calculators during exams at SU
text:
Students can no longer bring their own calculators to the exams. The only permitted calculators are those provided in the exam rooms. Modern calculators can have internet access and AI features, so for security reasons personal calculators are no longer allowed.


The calculator provided

The exam rooms provide the Sagitta scientific calculator.




Click the image for a larger version.



Here is a manual, for the truly curious.







ImportantHow to change the decimal notation



The Sagitta calculator may use scientific notation by default:

small numbers such as \(0.000032\) are shown as \(3.2 ^{-05}\) or \(3.2e\text{-}05\)
large numbers such as \(12000000\) are shown as \(1.2^{07}\) or \(1.2e\text{+}07\)

If you prefer to see these numbers written out in full, do the following:

Press the Mode button in the upper right several times until you see the screen below.





Press 3 to choose the Norm mode.
Press 2 to choose Norm 2. This mode switches to scientific notation only for very small and very large numbers.
